title: Refugees From Admiral Starks Fleet

Shanghai Municipal Police.

CENTRAL
（印：... Station.）

January 4 1925

REPORT ON Refugees from Admiral Stark's Fleet.

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal In...

Sir,

In reply to enquiries made on January 4 regarding the Russians who came here by Admiral Stark's fleet, Mr. V. Grosse, Deputy Commissioner for Russian Affairs, stated that these people have no intention of returning to the ships. The cadets in No. 4 Jessfield Road are being cared for by the Russian Benevolent Society, and the people in No. 116 Sinza Road have sufficient funds to keep them for two months. During that time the Deputy Commissioner will endeavour to get them employment on sugar plantation in the Hawaiian Islands, and if that scheme fails they will be sent to Harbin. The Deputy Commissioner believes that, if necessary, he can make arrangements to have any arms in their possession handed over to the police. The Deputy Commissioner for Russian Affairs adds that he only issued permits for the disembarkation from Admiral Stark's fleet to ninety adults approximately and one hundred and three cadets. The house at No. 116 Sinza Road was rented by the refugees themselves.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I. Givens
D. I.

（批：Aprl. D. C. I.）

中央
（印：...巡捕房。）

1925年1月4日

关于斯塔克海军上将舰队难民之报告。

由 D. I. Givens 呈报，经刑事调查处主任转呈

先生：

就1月4日关于乘斯塔克海军上将舰队来沪之俄国人所提出的询问，俄国事务副专员 V. Grosse 先生表示，这些人无意返回舰船。杰斯菲尔德路4号的士官生正由俄国慈善会照料，而新闸路116号的人员拥有足够维持两个月的资金。在此期间，副专员将设法为他们在夏威夷群岛的糖料种植园谋得职位，若该计划失败，他们将前往哈尔滨。副专员相信，如有必要，他可以安排将其持有的任何武器移交警方。俄国事务副专员补充称，他仅向约九十名成人和一百零三名士官生签发了从斯塔克海军上将舰队登陆的许可证。新闸路116号的房屋系由难民自行租赁。

此致，
阁下之恭顺仆人，
D. I. Givens
分区督察

（批注：Aprl. 刑事调查处主任。）

CENTRAL Station.
January 4 192 2

REPORT ON Apprehension of Trouble in Bureau for Russian
Affairs

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by

Sir,

With reference to attached, I beg to report that
I have conveyed the information about the visits of armed men to
Nos. 108, 109 Yangtsepoo Road to Chief Insp. O'Toole and
D.S.I. Quayle and have made arrangements that D.C. Korolkoff
attend the Bureau for Russian Affairs daily during the hours
mentioned until further orders. Nos. 108, 109 Yangtsepoo
Road is a restaurant kept by a Russian ex-officer named
Fenix Golovachevsky, and the party of armed Cossacks who
frequent the place comprise Colonel Ouchakoff, Lieutenant
Blohin and five or six others. A letter believed to emanate
from these people received by Mr. Hotzler in words as follows:
"You shall soon be in the place to which you belong".
These Cossacks are believed to have come to Shanghai by
Admiral Stark's fleet.

Efforts made on January 3 to see Mr. V. Grosse
as regards provisions for the future of the refugees in
No. 116 Sinza Road and 4 Jessfield Road were unsuccessful,
but will be repeated this morning.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I.

(批：Ost / H)
D. C. I.

1922年1月4日

关于俄国事务局预防骚乱之报告

由 D. I. Givens 呈报，经...转呈

先生：

关于附件内容，谨报告如下：
我已将武装人员访问杨树浦路108、109号的情况通报给总督察 O'Toole 和副分区督察 Quayle，并已作出安排，在接到进一步命令之前，让警佐 Korolkoff 在上述时间内每日前往俄国事务局值班。杨树浦路108、109号是一家由名为 Fenix Golovachevsky 的俄国前军官经营的餐馆，经常光顾此地的一伙武装哥萨克人包括 Ouchakoff 上校、Blohin 中尉及其他五六人。Hotzler 先生收到一封据信出自这些人之手的信件，内容如下：“你很快就会回到你所属的地方”。据信，这些哥萨克人是乘斯塔克海军上将的舰队来到上海的。

1月3日，就新闸路116号和杰斯菲尔德4号难民的未来安置问题试图会见 V. Grosse 先生的努力未获成功，但将于今晨再次尝试。

此致，
阁下之恭顺仆人，
D. I.

(批注：Ost / H)
刑事调查处主任。

C. I. D.
R. O. REC
4913
6/1/23

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
January 3, 1923.

REPORT ON Apprehension of Trouble in Bureau
for Russian Affairs.

Made by D. I. Givens. Forwarded by

Sir,

In response to a telephone message I called at 10.30
a.m. January 3 on Mr. V. Grosse, Vice Commissioner for Russian
Affairs, who reports that threats have been made by certain
Russian refugees against a member of his staff and requests
that a couple of armed policemen in plain clothes, including
one who speaks Russian, preferably D.C. Korolkoff, be placed
on guard inside the Consulate daily from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. during
which hours large numbers of refugees are in the habit of con-
gregating there. Mr. Grosse also suggests that the Police
make a surprise visit to Nos. 103, 107 Yangtsepoo Road, where
a group of Cossack officers clad partly in uniform and partly
in plain clothes, who are most aggressive of the malcontents,
are in the habit of taking their meals, and search them for
arms which they are believed to possess.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I. Givens
D. C. I.

（批：Ash / 4/1）

1923年1月3日。

关于俄国事务局预防骚乱之报告。

由 D. I. Givens 呈报。经...转呈

先生：

应电话通知，我于1月3日上午10时30分拜访了俄国事务副专员 V. Grosse 先生，他报告称，某些俄国难民对其一名职员发出了威胁，并请求每天上午9时至下午3时期间，在领事馆内安排两名便衣武装警察值守，其中包括一名懂俄语者，最好由警佐 Korolkoff 担任，因为在这段时间内，大量难民习惯聚集于此。Grosse 先生还建议警方对杨树浦路103、107号进行突击检查，那里有一群哥萨克军官，部分身着制服，部分身着便服，他们是最具攻击性的不满分子，习惯在此用餐，并搜查他们据信持有的武器。

此致，
阁下之恭顺仆人，
D. I. Givens
警佐

（批注：Ash / 4/1）
